item.title: Things to Do in Tamarindo: A First-Timer's Guide
item.description: A realistic look at what Tamarindo offers first-time visitors, who it suits, and how to use it as a base for exploring Guanacaste.

item.title: Which Airport for Guanacaste? LIR vs. SJO, Destination by Destination

item.title: Rincón de la Vieja: A Practical Guide to the Volcano, Waterfalls & Hot Springs
item.description: How to visit Rincón de la Vieja in Guanacaste: the national park’s trails, mud pots and waterfalls, plus the adjacent ranches with ziplines and hot springs.

item.title: Getting Around Guanacaste: Rental Car, Shuttle, or Tour Pickup?
item.description: How to get around Guanacaste, Costa Rica: flying into Liberia (LIR), when a rental car is worth it, shuttles and transfers, road realities, and tour pickups.

item.title: The Best Time to Visit Guanacaste: Dry Season vs. Green Season
item.description: When to visit Guanacaste, Costa Rica: how the dry and green seasons compare on weather, crowds, prices and scenery — and which one fits the trip you want.
